Node locations for distance computation  def node_loc(node):     if node in (START, END):         return depot['latitude'], depot['longitude']     return lat[int(node)], lon[int(node)]  from_nodes = [START] + S to_nodes = S + [END]  arcs = [] for i in from_nodes:     for j in to_nodes:         if i == j:             continue         if i == START and j == END:             continue         arcs.append((i, j))  # distances on arcs  dist = {} for i, j in arcs:     a_lat, a_lon = node_loc(i)     b_lat, b_lon = node_loc(j)     dist[i, j] = great_circle_miles(a_lat, a_lon, b_lat, b_lon)  model = Model('bike_rebalancing') model.hideOutput(True)  # Determinism for name, value in [     ('randomization/randomseedshift', 0),     ('randomization/permutationseed', 0),     ('randomization/lpseed', 0), ]:     try:         model.setParam(name, value)     except Exception:         pass for name in ['randomization/permutevars', 'randomization/permuteconss']:     try:         model.setParam(name, False)     except Exception:         pass try:     model.setParam('parallel/maxnthreads', 1) except Exception:     pass  x = {(v, i, j): model.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'x_{v}_{i}_{j}') for v in V for (i, j) in arcs}  visit = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'visit_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S}  pick = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'pick_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S}  pu = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=0, ub=vehicle_capacity, name=f'pu_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S} do = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=0, ub=vehicle_capacity, name=f'do_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S}  service = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=-vehicle_capacity, ub=vehicle_capacity, name=f'svc_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S}  load_start = {v: model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=0, ub=vehicle_capacity, name=f'load_start_{v}') for v in V} load_end = {v: model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=0, ub=vehicle_capacity, name=f'load_end_{v}') for v in V} load = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=0, ub=vehicle_capacity, name=f'load_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S}  # Route constraints for v in V:     model.addCons(quicksum(x[v, START, j] for j in S) == 1, name=f'start_{v}')     model.addCons(quicksum(x[v, i, END] for i in S) == 1, name=f'end_{v}')      for i in S:         incoming = quicksum(x[v, j, i] for j in from_nodes if j != i and (j, i) in dist)         outgoing = quicksum(x[v, i, j] for j in to_nodes if j != i and (i, j) in dist)         model.addCons(incoming == outgoing, name=f'flow_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(outgoing <= 1, name=f'atmostonce_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(visit[v, i] == outgoing, name=f'visitlink_{v}_{i}')  # Subtour elimination (MTZ) order = {(v, i): model.addVar(vtype='C', lb=0.0, ub=float(n), name=f'ord_{v}_{i}') for v in V for i in S} for v in V:     for i in S:         model.addCons(order[v, i] <= n * visit[v, i], name=f'ordlink_{v}_{i}')      for i in S:         for j in S:             if i == j:                 continue             if (i, j) in dist:                 model.addCons(order[v, i] - order[v, j] + n * x[v, i, j] <= n - 1, name=f'mtz_{v}_{i}_{j}')  # Operation constraints for v in V:     for i in S:         model.addCons(service[v, i] == pu[v, i] - do[v, i], name=f'svcdef_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(pu[v, i] <= vehicle_capacity * visit[v, i], name=f'pulink_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(do[v, i] <= vehicle_capacity * visit[v, i], name=f'dolink_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(pu[v, i] <= vehicle_capacity * pick[v, i], name=f'pusign_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(do[v, i] <= vehicle_capacity * (1 - pick[v, i]), name=f'dosign_{v}_{i}')  # Load propagation along arcs M = 2 * vehicle_capacity  for v in V:     # START -> station     for j in S:         model.addCons(load[v, j] - load_start[v] - service[v, j] <= M * (1 - x[v, START, j]), name=f'loadS_up_{v}_{j}')         model.addCons(load[v, j] - load_start[v] - service[v, j] >= -M * (1 - x[v, START, j]), name=f'loadS_lo_{v}_{j}')      # station -> station     for i in S:         for j in S:             if i == j:                 continue             if (i, j) not in dist:                 continue             model.addCons(load[v, j] - load[v, i] - service[v, j] <= M * (1 - x[v, i, j]), name=f'load_up_{v}_{i}_{j}')             model.addCons(load[v, j] - load[v, i] - service[v, j] >= -M * (1 - x[v, i, j]), name=f'load_lo_{v}_{i}_{j}')      # station -> END     for i in S:         model.addCons(load_end[v] - load[v, i] <= M * (1 - x[v, i, END]), name=f'loadE_up_{v}_{i}')         model.addCons(load_end[v] - load[v, i] >= -M * (1 - x[v, i, END]), name=f'loadE_lo_{v}_{i}')  # Station inventory and unmet penalty net_change = {i: quicksum(service[v, i] for v in V) for i in S}  dev = {i: model.addVar(vtype='I', lb=0, name=f'dev_{i}') for i in S}  for i in S:     # final inventory bounds: 0 <= initial - net_change <= cap     model.addCons(net_change[i] <= initial[i], name=f'inv_lb_{i}')     model.addCons(net_change[i] >= initial[i] - cap_station[i], name=f'inv_ub_{i}')      model.addCons(target[i] - net_change[i] <= dev[i], name=f'dev1_{i}')     model.addCons(net_change[i] - target[i] <= dev[i], name=f'dev2_{i}')  travel_cost = quicksum(dist[i, j] * x[v, i, j] for v in V for (i, j) in arcs) penalty_cost = penalty_weight * quicksum(dev[i] for i in S)  model.setObjective(travel_cost + penalty_cost, 'minimize')  model.setParam('limits/time', 60.0) model.setParam('limits/gap', 0.0)  model.optimize()  if model.getNSols() == 0:     raise RuntimeError(f'No solution found, status={model.getStatus()}')  # Extract solution  def is_one(var):     return model.getVal(var) > 0.5  vehicle_reports = []  # Precompute distances for extraction  def route_distance(route_nodes):     total = 0.0     for a, b in zip(route_nodes, route_nodes[1:]):         total += dist[a, b]     return total  for v in V:     succ = {}     for (i, j) in arcs:         if is_one(x[v, i, j]):             succ[i] = j      # follow route from START     route = [START]     cur = START     seen = {START}     while cur != END:         if cur not in succ:             raise RuntimeError(f'vehicle {v} route disconnected at {cur!r}')         cur = succ[cur]         if cur in seen and cur != END:             raise RuntimeError(f'vehicle {v} cycle detected at {cur!r}')         route.append(cur)         seen.add(cur)      stops = []     for node in route[1:-1]:         i = int(node)         sid = idx_to_id[i]         pu_val = int(round(model.getVal(pu[v, i])))         do_val = int(round(model.getVal(do[v, i])))         load_val = int(round(model.getVal(load[v, i])))         # sanity: no both positive         if pu_val > 0 and do_val > 0:             raise RuntimeError('pickup and dropoff both positive at a stop')         stops.append({             'station_id': sid,             'bikes_picked_up': float(pu_val),             'bikes_dropped_off': float(do_val),             'load_after_stop': float(load_val),         })      vehicle_reports.append({         'vehicle_id': v + 1,         'start_load': float(int(round(model.getVal(load_start[v])))),         'route': [route[0]] + [idx_to_id[int(n)] for n in route[1:-1]] + [route[-1]],         'stops': stops,         'end_load': float(int(round(model.getVal(load_end[v])))),     })  # Station totals station_reports = []  total_unmet = 0.0 for i in S:     sid = idx_to_id[i]     total_pu = 0     total_do = 0     for v in V:         total_pu += int(round(model.getVal(pu[v, i])))         total_do += int(round(model.getVal(do[v, i])))     net = total_pu - total_do     unmet = abs(float(target[i] - net))     total_unmet += unmet     station_reports.append({         'station_id': sid,         'net_rebalancing_target': float(target[i]),         'total_bikes_picked_up': float(total_pu),         'total_bikes_dropped_off': float(total_do),         'net_bike_change': float(net),         'unmet_rebalancing_amount': float(unmet),     })  # Travel distance (from extracted routes) travel_distance = 0.0 for vr in vehicle_reports:     internal_route = [START] + [id_to_idx[int(sid)] for sid in vr['route'][1:-1]] + [END]     travel_distance += route_distance(internal_route)  unmet_penalty = penalty_weight * total_unmet objective = travel_distance + unmet_penalty  report = {     'summary': {         'objective': float(objective),         'travel_distance_miles': float(travel_distance),         'unmet_rebalancing_penalty': float(unmet_penalty),         'total_unmet_rebalancing_amount': float(total_unmet),     },     'vehicles': vehicle_reports,     'stations': station_reports, }  REPORT_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=False) + '\n')  # Basic verification print('WROTE', str(REPORT_PATH)) print('objective', objective) print('travel', travel_distance) print('unmet', total_unmet, 'penalty', unmet_penalty) PY
